subject: Timeline deceleration notice and priority ladder for HelioCare MAP
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: aisha.patel@heliocare.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioCare MAP — slipping milestones (initial risk note)

Team — looping you in early:

HelioCare flagged a procurement checkpoint delay this morning that will push out their internal evaluation windows by ~2 weeks unless we escalate. I attached the current MAP (HelioCare_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a quick risk snapshot (risk_log_20260922.csv).

Key points:
- Procurement approval for encryption KMS is now targeted for 09/20 instead of 09/06 (internal note from Aisha).
- Their pilot cohort availability compresses evaluation from 3 weeks to ~10 days if we keep the current cutover date.
- This increases risk on the go-live window and could cause contract acceptance to miss the quarter close.

Ask: can we (a) prioritize a Dedicated slot for their pilot the week of 09/27 to preserve evaluation quality, and (b) consider a one-time onboarding credit if they need an extension to keep momentum?

Irene — can you confirm availability for a canary allocation? Karthik — I need a short note on tactical mitigations (reduced seq length, smaller batch profiles) that buy us latency room without significant cost. Marissa — if we need executive approval for concession (credit/priority), please advise next steps.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@heliocare.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliocare.com, Ben Torres <ben.torres@heliocare.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioCare MAP — slipping milestones (initial risk note)

Thanks Logan — quick confirmation from our side:

- KMS vendor sign-off is delayed due to an internal security review; new target 09/20.
- Procurement acknowledged the impact and will prioritize but cannot guarantee earlier.
- We absolutely want to avoid shrinking the pilot cohort; the evaluation quality depends on representative traffic.

We appreciate any help with short-term Dedicated capacity and are open to a one-time credit discussion — that would reduce the friction for us to accept the timeline extension. Attached: evaluation_plan_deltas.pdf showing how the pilot schedule shifts if the KMS slips.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Product Operations, HelioCare
From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aisha.patel@heliocare.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCare MAP — slipping milestones (initial risk note)

Logan — I can confirm a short canary allocation for 09/27-10/01 on a single DGX node with prioritized queueing. This should preserve throughput for the pilot cohort.

Karthik — if you can send a short mitigation plan by EOD we can lock the slot; we will bill at standard Dedicated rates unless leadership advises otherwise.

Irene Choi
Sr. Infra Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aisha.patel@heliocare.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCare MAP — slipping milestones (initial risk note)

Team — quick tactical mitigations that buy headroom without a heavy rework: 

1) Evaluation profile: reduce max generation length from 1024 to 512 for pilot workloads — expected token-cost reduction ~38% and latency improvement ~12–15%.
2) Batching: enable aggressive micro-batching for non-latency-critical evaluation runs; keep streaming traffic at standard batch sizes.
3) KV caching: pre-warm prefix cache for the first 2k traffic samples; should shave warm-start latency on day one.

If the customer accepts these compromises for the pilot, the Dedicated canary will comfortably handle the window. Logging a short mitigation note in the shared folder.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, aisha.patel@heliocare.com, procurement@heliocare.com
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: request for one-time onboarding credit and priority slot confirmation

Marissa — per above, HelioCare is willing to accept a two-week re-baseline but expects operational support to keep evaluation fidelity. They asked about a one-time onboarding credit to offset the procurement-driven delay. Details:
- Customer impact: evaluation start shifts from 09/13 to 09/27 (pilot intact but compressed).
- Value: HelioCare is a strategic vertical play; closing this quarter materially affects our Q3 vertical momentum.
- Proposed concession: a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to 10% of the first-month usage (applied if they sign the SOW by 09/30).

Decision needed: approve the credit? If yes, I will formalize the concession and update the MAP and HubSpot deal. If no, we need to surface alternative trade-offs (e.g., no credit but guaranteed pricing cap for month 1).

Logan
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, irene.choi@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: aisha.patel@heliocare.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: request for one-time onboarding credit and priority slot confirmation

Thanks everyone — after reviewing the account and strategic context I approve a one-time onboarding credit at the 10% level, conditional on the following:

- HelioCare signs the SOW addendum by 2026-09-30 and confirms the 09/27 canary start window in writing.
- We include a two-week extension clause in the MAP that explicitly states evaluation dates and acceptance criteria to avoid ambiguity.
- Finance to apply credit post-invoice on the first monthly bill; Marissa will coordinate with billing. (internal note: finance ticket FIN-8462)

Aisha — please confirm you can execute the signature by 09/30 and confirm procurement will prioritize the KMS approval to meet 09/20. Logan/Irene/Karthik — lock the Dedicated slot for 09/27 and post the updated MAP to the shared Drive folder.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

On approval, I will update HubSpot and send the formal addendum doc link.
